adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `basePath(store, type)` to check `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-'))` (rest.js.es6). In JS, `String#replace('_','-')` only replaces the first underscore, so types containing multiple underscores would not be fully normalized before the admin-model lookup. The diff does not show any current model types with multiple underscores being passed here (the added admin model `embeddable-host` corresponds to a single-underscore `embeddable_host` case), so it’s not a verifiable broken behavior from this PR, but it is a concrete edge-case/robustness issue introduced by the new normalization approach.
